Actuator catalogue: development handoff

Robot Body Atlas v0.2.1 · Snapshot: 29 October 2026. This is a research catalogue, not a standardized independent benchmark or a procurement ranking.

The interface, filters and catalogue summaries support Chinese and English. Source-specific technical notes, manufacturer documents, papers, JSON downloads and the original performance workbook retain their original language. Translation does not change a numeric value, unit, evidence level or hardware revision.

Project structure and coverage

The five sections are Actuators → Quadrupeds → Humanoids → Robot Arms → Dexterous Hands. The current catalogue includes 95 actuator configurations from 12 brands, 61 quadruped configurations, 56 humanoid records and 19 hand records. Robot Arms is a planned section for single- and dual-arm platforms.

Actuator definitions

  • Rated/continuous, peak and stall torque are independent fields. Missing torque types are never filled from another type.
  • Motor shaft and integrated-module output values are separate. Frameless motors have no inferred gearbox ratio.
  • Encoder count follows explicit documentation. Input and output resolution, repeatability and absolute accuracy differ.
  • Voltage, generation and ratio variants are separate records. Unknown is not zero.

Data and evidence

Each numeric metric retains its source, manual page where available, unit and test condition. Images retain attribution. Robot installation links distinguish confirmed evidence from family-level or incomplete associations. Maximum robot joint torque does not identify an actuator model or rate every joint.

Maintaining the catalogue

Edit the research JSON in research/actuators/ and regenerate with scripts/build-actuators.py. The browser reads dist/data/actuators.json. Pure filter and export logic lives in actuator-logic.js; presentation lives in actuators.js. Run the catalogue checks, preview desktop and narrow layouts, then package and publish to the existing Site identity.

v0.2 localization

The language control remembers Chinese or English, supports a lang query parameter, and preserves active filters, detail state and comparison selections. Canonical IDs, option values and numeric evidence remain unchanged. Edit research/i18n/en.tsv and regenerate with scripts/build-i18n.py. Untranslated source-specific notes remain in their original language. Add reviewed translations rather than guessing technical meaning.

Next work

Expand continuous operating envelopes, cooling, motor constants, inertia, backlash, stiffness, protocols, encoder accuracy, CAD dimensions, current availability and laboratory evidence. Build explicit body–actuator–end-effector links before drawing system-performance conclusions. Preserve original versions and archived releases.

Read the full original Chinese handoff for the complete source-language technical record. The English page is a maintained guide, not a replacement for the original evidence.
